summary.text: Ashlee Matthews is a Democratic state representative from Utah House of Representatives District 37 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists her profession as nonprofit executive.

paragraphs.text: Ashlee Matthews was born in West Valley, Utah.
According to Ballotpedia, her career experience includes working with the Utah Department of Transportation and serving as director of events and co-founder of The Single Parent Project.
She has served as a mentor with Big Brothers Big Sisters of Utah and as a Giving Tree coordinator for the UA Local 140 Ladies Auxiliary.
In the 2023-2024 legislative term, Matthews was assigned to the House Ethics Committee, as co-chair, the House Rules Committee and the Transportation Committee.
